original_hypothesis.hypothesis: Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.

actual_before.reason: Receiving Party may reproduce Data with prior written consent.

actual_after.reason: Reproduction of Data is allowed with prior written consent.

exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.107: Except as set forth in Section III, Data Recipient shall not reproduce the Data in any form without the prior written consent of DOHMH.

actual_applicable_criteria.criterion: Test the specific act of creating or reproducing a copy. Entailment requires an operative authorization to make copies in stated circumstances. Contradiction applies to an operative prohibition on copying or reproduction, including a consent-qualified prohibition unless another clause affirmatively grants the relevant copying permission. Do not infer permission from authorized use, access, possession, recordkeeping, reducing information to writing, delivery of existing copies, or permission to retain one already-existing archival copy. Cite the actor, copying verb, modality, and any condition or exception that controls the prohibition or permission. If the document regulates related handling but never settles creation of copies, return NotMentioned.

original_hypothesis.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any objects which embody Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

actual_before.reason: No mention of reverse engineering in the contract.

actual_after.reason: Confidential Information includes individually identifiable information, which may be reverse engineered.

exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.76: Data Recipient shall not disclose Data, or any information it receives pursuant to this Agreement that is individually identifiable information, or information, which combined with publicly available information, may reasonably be used to identify an individual.
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.77: Individually Identifying Information must be maintained in a manner approved by DOHMH, and consistent with applicable laws rules and regulations.

actual_applicable_criteria.criterion: Match the contractual actor, action, object, polarity, and trigger exactly. Limited use is supported by an operative sole-purpose or no-other-purpose restriction; cite the incorporated purpose definition when needed and all independently operative use restrictions, but not merely adjacent disclosure or security terms. Compelled-disclosure notice requires advance, prompt, or otherwise responsive notice or consultation triggered by legal, regulatory, court, or comparable compulsory disclosure; incident, breach, or loss reporting does not qualify. A no-reverse-engineering conclusion requires an express prohibition on reverse engineering the protected object and must not be inferred from no-license, ownership, no-copy, or limited-use language. No solicitation requires an express ban on soliciting or inducing the specified representatives or employees; restrictions on using names, contacting information sources, advertising, or ordinary disclosure do not settle it. For each hypothesis, an express permission for the same conduct opposes a prohibition, while silence or regulation of a neighboring act is NotMentioned. Cite the operative duty or permission with any definition, condition, exception, duration, or trigger necessary to delimit it.

original_hypothesis.hypothesis: Confidential Information shall only include technical information.

exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.14: WHEREAS, certain portions of the technical, marketing and business information which are to be disclosed may be of a confidential and/or proprietary character and include trade secrets of the Disclosor (hereinafter "Confidential Information"), it is necessary to restrict the Recipient's use of the Confidential Information.
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.19: 2. As used herein, the term "Confidential Information" shall be deemed to include any technical, marketing, business and trade secret information disclosed by the Disclosor, but excludes such information which:
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.20: (a) is presently in Recipient's possession, provided that:
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.21: (i) such information has not been obtained from the Disclosor;
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.22: (ii) that such possession can be demonstrated by the Recipient's written records and
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.23: (iii) that Recipient so informs Disclosor in writing within 30 days from receipt of such Confidential Information;
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.24: (b) is, or becomes, generally available to the public through, for example, such sources as patents or other generally circulated publications, and such availability to the public does not result from any fault of the Recipient;
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.25: (c) is received by the Recipient in written form from a third party having no obligation to the Disclosor to keep it confidential; or
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.26: (d) is independently developed by the Recipient provided that such development can be demonstrated by the Recipient's written records.

actual_applicable_criteria.criterion: Read the complete definition, its alternatives, any marking or confirmation rule, and the operative confidentiality duty. For explicit identification, Entailment requires identification, marking, or confirmation to govern the protected information; Contradiction applies when unmarked information is protected through blanket categories, its nature, circumstances, or a reasonable-person test. Do not cite a marking subclause alone when an alternative protects unmarked information. For technical-only scope, Contradiction requires express inclusion of identifiable non-technical categories; a generic reference to confidential, proprietary, non-public, or business-related material does not by itself settle the exclusivity claim. For oral information, require language expressly covering oral or comparable non-tangible disclosure, or a rule expressly bringing such disclosure within protection; do not infer oral coverage merely from the word information or from discussions occurring. For confidentiality of the agreement or negotiations, require language covering the agreement, contractual arrangements, negotiation communications, or their existence together with an operative nondisclosure duty; confidentiality of contemplated discussions alone is insufficient. Cite the whole responsive definition when its opening language, list, and terminal modality jointly establish scope, but exclude illustrative categories that do not bear on the tested boundary. Return NotMentioned whenever the exact form, subject, or exclusivity issue remains unsettled.

original_hypothesis.hypothesis: Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.

actual_before.reason: Receiving Party must notify Disclosing Party of compelled disclosure.

actual_after.reason: Notice on compelled disclosure is required.

exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.37: If the Party faces legal action to disclose Confidential Information received under this Agreement, then the Party shall promptly notify the other Party in order that it may have the opportunity to intercede and contest such disclosure and, upon request, shall cooperate with the other Party in contesting such a disclosure.
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.38: Except in connection with failure to discharge the responsibilities set forth in the preceding sentence, neither Party shall be liable in damages for any disclosures pursuant to such legal action.

actual_before.reason: Receiving Party must notify Disclosing Party of legal requirements to disclose Confidential Information.

actual_after.reason: Receiving Party must notify disclosing Party of legal requirements to disclose.

exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.24: If receiving Party is required by applicable law, or by process issued in connection with a judicial or administrative proceeding, to disclose any of disclosing Party’s Proprietary Information, receiving Party shall immediately notify disclosing Party of such legal requirement or the issuance of such process so disclosing Party has the opportunity to seek a protective order.
exact_original_text_for_all_Gold_and_act.25: If disclosing Party fails to obtain a protective order, receiving Party may disclose only those pieces of Proprietary Information that it is legally required to disclose.
